svg.text: DOVME BAKIR AKUSTIK REZONANS: CHLADNI DUGUM HARITALARI & SOGUK DOVME SPEKTRUMU
NODAL CONDITION: cos(n*pi*r)*cos(m*theta) = 0 | WORK-HARDENING STIFFNESS INCREASES YOUNG'S MODULUS & OVERTONES
01 // BAKIR DISK UZERINDE DURAGAN DALGA DUGUM CIZGILERI (CHLADNI NODAL LINES)
Her cekic darbesi bakirin kristal kafesini siklastirir (soğuk dovme / work-hardening).
Yerel kalinlik h(r, theta) degistikce yuzeydeki rezonans dugum geometri haritasi yeniden kurulur.
Black contours = zero displacement sand nodes | Center dot = hammer excitation / transducer mount
